title.en: Lieutenant Governor visits the construction site of the Nurzhan Compute Park
title.ir: Vitse-gubernator Nurzhan Compute Park kurulush ayantın kördü
title.ru: Вице-губернатор посетил стройплощадку Нуржанского вычислительного парка

summary.en: Aidar Maksat and the Director-General of Attelkom, Samat Kasymov, inspected the first phase of a planned US$450 million data-centre hub in Nurzhan's Eastern Industrial Zone.
summary.ir: Aidar Maksat jana Attelkomdun bash direktoru Samat Kasymov Nurzhandın Chıgısh önör jay zonasındagı 450 million dollarlık maalımat borborunun birinchi bagıtın kördü.
summary.ru: Айдар Максат и генеральный директор «Аттелкома» Самат Касымов осмотрели первую очередь центра обработки данных стоимостью 450 млн долларов в Восточной промзоне Нуржана.

en: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat on Monday visited the construction site of the Nurzhan Compute Park in the Eastern Industrial Zone of Nurzhan, Chu District. He was accompanied by the Director-General of Attelkom, Samat Kasymov.

The park is planned as a hub for cloud computing and artificial-intelligence services. The project is estimated at about US$450 million over several phases. The first phase, of about US$110 million, is designed for 40 megawatts of load, rising to 150 megawatts as later phases are built. About 300 permanent jobs are expected once the park is in operation.

Power will be supplied from natural gas through the Nurzhan central heat and power plant, with grid electricity from the Toktogul hydropower complex as back-up. Attelkom is designing fibre links from the park to the Attelkom Data Center in Talas and to the national network alongside the halls themselves.

“This is the ISEZ keeping pace with the region,” the Lieutenant Governor said at the site. “Our neighbours in Kazakhstan are building data centres at speed. We intend that Iradi data and Iradi computing power are kept at home, and that the jobs and the investment stay in Nurzhan.”
Further information on equipment suppliers and on the gas, water and grid connections will be released as each phase is contracted. Construction of the first phase continues.

title.en: 88 investment agreements worth US$2.4 billion signed in three years
title.ir: Üch jılda 2,4 milliard dollarlık 88 investitsiyalık kelishim tüzüldü
title.ru: За три года подписано 88 инвестиционных соглашений на 2,4 млрд долларов

summary.en: The first full tally of investment agreements since late 2023 shows energy, antimony and logistics drawing most foreign capital.
summary.ir: 2023-jıldın akırınan beri tüzülgön kelishimderdin algachkı toluk esebi: chet el kapitalının köbü energetikaga, sürmögö jana logistikaga keldi.
summary.ru: Первый полный подсчёт соглашений с конца 2023 года: больше всего иностранного капитала привлекли энергетика, сурьма и логистика.

en: The Irad Special Economic Zone has signed 88 investment agreements worth a combined US$2.4 billion over the past three years, the ISEZ Investment Promotion Office said in Talas on Monday.

The agreements range from small cold-chain and packaging contracts in the Talas Agro-Industrial and Economic Zone to large energy and mining commitments. About a third of the total value is tied to power generation and transmission, led by the refit of the Toktogul hydropower complex. Most agreements are already at the construction or procurement stage.

“Investors tell us three things: they want a predictable dollar-denominated contract, a single counter to deal with, and a government that answers its telephone,” said Kirill Zhdanov, head of the Investment Promotion Office.

“Capital follows confidence, and confidence is built contract by contract,” Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat said. He added that the census of business entities opened last week would give the government “a clearer map of who is here, who wants to expand and what they need”.
The office will publish a disbursement update in the spring. A further group of agreements in agro-processing and logistics is expected to be signed before the end of the year.

source.en: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources
source.ir: Ayıl charba jana suu baylıktarı ministrligi
source.ru: Министерство сельского хозяйства и водных ресурсов

title.en: Draft order on a temporary halt to table potato imports published for comment
title.ir: Tamak-ash kartoshkasın import kıluunu ubaktıluu toktotuu boyuncha buyruktun dolbooru talkuuga chıgarıldı
title.ru: Проект приказа о временном запрете ввоза столового картофеля вынесен на обсуждение

summary.en: After a record harvest of about 210,000 tonnes, the ministry proposes to stop imports of table potatoes until 1 March 2027. Comments are open until 30 October.
summary.ir: Boljolu 210 000 tonna rekordduk tüshümdön kiyin ministrlik 2027-jıldın 1-martına cheyin tamak-ash kartoshkasın import kıluunu toktotuunu sunushtayt. Pikirler 30-oktyabrga cheyin kabıl alınat.
summary.ru: После рекордного урожая около 210 тыс. тонн министерство предлагает прекратить ввоз столового картофеля до 1 марта 2027 года. Замечания принимаются до 30 октября.

en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources has published a draft order that would suspend imports of table potatoes into the Irad Special Economic Zone until 1 March 2027. Seed potatoes are exempt.

This autumn's harvest in the Chu and Talas valleys is the largest on record, at about 210,000 tonnes. The restriction is intended to give growers room to sell their crop while cellars are full, and would be reviewed if retail prices rose.

“The harvest is large enough to cover the table all winter, and we want to be sure that imported tubers do not crowd out our growers while the cellars are full,” said Pavel Gorbunov, deputy head of the ministry's crop production department.
Growers' associations, traders and hauliers are invited to send written comments until 30 October 2026. The final decision will be announced through the Department of Public Information.

title.en: Census of business entities begins: enumerators visit firms, farms and stalls until 30 November
title.ir: Ishkanalardın sanagı bashtaldı: kattoochular 30-noyabrga cheyin firmalardı, dıykan charbaların jana sooda orundarın kıdırat
title.ru: Начата перепись хозяйствующих субъектов: счётчики обходят фирмы, фермы и торговые места до 30 ноября

summary.en: The first count of all business entities in the ISEZ runs from 15 October to 30 November. Answers are used for statistics only.
summary.ir: IAEZdegi bardık ishkanalardın algachkı sanagı 15-oktyabrdan 30-noyabrga cheyin jürgüzülöt. Jooptor statistika üchün gana koldonulat.
summary.ru: Первая перепись всех хозяйствующих субъектов ОЭЗИ проходит с 15 октября по 30 ноября. Ответы используются только для статистики.

en: The first census of business entities in the Irad Special Economic Zone began on 15 October and will run until 30 November 2026, under Executive Directive 2026/24.

About 1,800 enumerators, most of them teachers and students of Talas State University, will visit registered companies, farms, workshops, market stalls and home businesses in the three cities and the six districts. The questionnaire takes about 25 minutes. Businesses may also complete it at Attelkom service points.

The register currently lists about 41,000 entities, and the real number of active businesses is expected to be considerably higher. “For thirty years we have planned the economy from tax filings and bank statistics,” Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat said. “Those tell us a great deal about NurGaz and Talasbank, and very little about a family selling apricots from a cart. This census is about seeing the whole economy.”

Answers are used for statistical purposes only and are not passed to tax inspectors. Business owners are asked to receive enumerators and to keep their ID card ready. Enumerators carry a Statistics Office card with a photograph and never ask for payment.
Preliminary results are due in the new year, ahead of the 2027 budget review.

title.en: Preliminary harvest figures: 1.2 million tonnes of grain and 210,000 tonnes of potatoes
title.ir: Tüshümdün aldın ala jıyıntıgı: 1,2 million tonna dan jana 210 000 tonna kartoshka
title.ru: Предварительные итоги уборки: 1,2 млн тонн зерна и 210 тыс. тонн картофеля

summary.en: The Chu and Talas valleys have brought in one of the strongest harvests in years. Grain is up by about two-fifths on last year.
summary.ir: Chüy jana Talas örööndörü akırkı jıldardagı eñ jakshı tüshümdördün birin jıynadı. Dan ötkön jılga karaganda boljolu beshten ekige köböydü.
summary.ru: Чуйская и Таласская долины собрали один из лучших урожаев за многие годы. Зерна примерно на две пятых больше, чем в прошлом году.

en: Preliminary figures from the district agriculture departments show a harvest of about 1.2 million tonnes of grain (wheat, barley and field maize) and about 210,000 tonnes of potatoes in the ISEZ this year.

The grain total is about 340,000 tonnes higher than at the same point last year, and potato output is up by more than a quarter. The departments credit a kinder growing season, steady canal rotations in Kara-Buura and Talas districts, and the second full year of lining and laser-levelling under the Irrigation Modernization Programme.

Storage capacity at the district elevators will be reviewed before the winter. The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources and the district departments will publish final harvest figures in November.

title.en: Phased restart announced for the Sary-Bulak Antimony Works and the Chatkal smelter
title.ir: Sarı-Bulak sürmö kombinatın jana Chatkal eritüü zavodun baskıchtap kayra ishtetüü jarıyalandı
title.ru: Объявлен поэтапный перезапуск Сары-Булакского сурьмяного комбината и Чаткальского завода

summary.en: Speaking to residents and plant staff in Sary-Bulak, the Lieutenant Governor said idle lines will return in stages, with the first stage expected to create around 600 jobs.
summary.ir: Sarı-Bulakta turgundar jana kızmatkerler menen jolugushuuda Vitse-gubernator toktop turgan liniyalar baskıchtap ishke kirerin, birinchi baskıch 600gö jakın jumush orun bererin ayttı.
summary.ru: Выступая перед жителями и работниками комбината в Сары-Булаке, вице-губернатор сказал, что простаивающие линии будут запускаться поэтапно; первая очередь даст около 600 рабочих мест.

en: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat on Monday announced the phased return to production of idle lines at the Sary-Bulak Antimony Works and the Chatkal Chemical Smelting Complex, at a meeting with residents and plant staff in Sary-Bulak.

The first stage is expected to create around 600 jobs, with recruitment prioritised for workers from Lower Naryn and Chu districts, where seasonal farm work leaves many households short of winter income. The first stage is estimated at about US$25 million, financed from the works' own reserves, Talasbank credit and private partners, who will be named at signing.
“We will not pretend the export controls do not matter,” the Lieutenant Governor said. “Our answer is a wider customer list and more value added in Irad, not a larger pile of raw concentrate.”

The Minister of Natural Resources, Chingiz Asanov, said the programme includes tighter licensing of ore sourcing. “Ore that is weighed, papered and processed here brings wages and royalties home,” he said.
The Ministry of Natural Resources will publish the first hiring notices this month. The first Sary-Bulak lines are due to restart before the end of the year, with Chatkal to follow in spring.

title.en: Customs roadmap with Kazakhstan for 2027–2028 signed at Kyzyl-Adyr
title.ir: Kazakstan menen 2027–2028-jıldarga bajı jol kartası Kızıl-Adırda kol koyuldu
title.ru: В Кызыл-Адыре подписана таможенная дорожная карта с Казахстаном на 2027–2028 годы

summary.en: Electronic pre-clearance at the Talas North Terminal, a shared schedule of inspection hours and a separate lane for low-risk lorries.
summary.ir: Talas Tündük terminalında elektronduk aldın ala tarizdöö, teksherüü saattarının jalpı grafigi jana tobokeldigi tömön jük tashuuchular üchün özünchö tilke.
summary.ru: Электронное предварительное оформление на Таласском северном терминале, общий график часов досмотра и отдельная полоса для грузовиков низкого риска.

en: The ISEZ Customs Service and Kazakhstan's customs authority on Monday signed a roadmap for 2027 and 2028 at the Kyzyl-Adyr district offices.

Under the roadmap, carriers will file declarations electronically before reaching the frontier, the two services will exchange manifest data for bonded loads in advance, and lorries flagged as low-risk will use a separate lane at the Talas North Terminal. The ISEZ side will provide two vehicle scanners and the declaration software.
Like the 2008 Northern Border Demarcation Protocol, the roadmap is a technical document. Inspections remain coordinated by the two services.
“A driver should know before he leaves Talas how long the frontier will take,” said Anvar Sultanbekov, deputy director of the Customs Service.

The Office of the Lieutenant Governor is also reviewing slot scheduling at the terminal with its Kazakh counterparts, so that Iradi grain, feed and cotton-thread shipments keep their places in the harvest weeks while transit volumes are high.

title.en: Toktogul refit raises capacity to 1,440 MW
title.ir: Toktogul GESi jañılangandan kiyin kuvattuulugu 1 440 MVtga jetti
title.ru: После модернизации мощность Токтогульской ГЭС выросла до 1440 МВт

summary.en: Each of the four generating units now delivers 360 MW instead of 300. The Minister of Natural Resources reviewed the work at the Lower Naryn switchyard and the National Dispatch Centre.
summary.ir: Tört generatordun ar biri emi 300 emes, 360 MVt beret. Ministr ishti Tömönkü Narındagı bölüshtürüü tüyününö jana Uluttuk dispetcherdik borborgo barıp kördü.
summary.ru: Каждый из четырёх агрегатов теперь выдаёт 360 МВт вместо 300. Министр ознакомился с работами на нижненарынской подстанции и в Национальном диспетчерском центре.

en: The Minister of Natural Resources, Chingiz Asanov, on Saturday reviewed the completed refit of the Toktogul hydropower complex, whose capacity has risen from 1,200 MW to 1,440 MW. The last of the four refitted units returned to service in September.

The minister visited the switchyard and the National Dispatch Centre in Lower Naryn District and met members of the joint technical commission of the Naryn Water and Power Protocol, with the Uzbek, Kazakh and Kyrgyz observer delegations present.

“Toktogul is a shared asset, and it has been improved in a shared way,” the minister said. “More capacity does not mean a different water schedule. The Protocol sets the schedule, and the machines simply serve it better.”

The additional output gives grid operators more room at the winter peak, when export demand is highest. A joint load test of the units will be held before winter, with results reported to the commission and the observer delegations.

title.en: Statement on the restriction of websites offering unlicensed financial services
title.ir: Litsenziyasız finansılık kızmat sunushtagan sayttardı chektöö boyuncha bildirüü
title.ru: Заявление об ограничении доступа к сайтам, предлагающим нелицензированные финансовые услуги

summary.en: At the request of financial supervisors, the website of the “Tulparcoin” token and the foreign platform on which it trades have been added to the list of restricted sites.
summary.ir: Finansılık közömöldööchülördün suroosu boyuncha “Tulparcoin” tokeninin saytı jana al satılgan chet eldik platforma chektelgen sayttar tizmesine kirgizildi.
summary.ru: По просьбе финансовых надзорных органов сайт токена «Тулпаркоин» и зарубежная площадка, на которой он торгуется, внесены в список ограниченных сайтов.

en: The Department of Public Information has added the website of the token marketed as “Tulparcoin” and the foreign exchange platform on which it is traded to the list of restricted sites that it supplies to telecommunications operators.
The department acted at the request of financial supervisors, to protect citizens from unlicensed financial activity. Messaging services are not affected.

The Department reminds residents that the som and the United States dollar are the only legal tender in the Irad Special Economic Zone, and that questions about savings and investments should be taken to a licensed bank.

title.en: Lieutenant Governor opens a solar-powered school in Navbahor, Nurzhan
title.ir: Vitse-gubernator Nurzhandın Navbahor rayonunda kün energiyası menen ishtegen mektepti achtı
title.ru: Вице-губернатор открыл школу на солнечной энергии в нуржанском районе Навбахор

summary.en: The 24-classroom school is the twelfth school or kindergarten completed this year. Eighteen more are due before the end of December.
summary.ir: 24 klasstuu mektep bıyıl bütkön on ekinchi mektep je bala bakcha. Dekabrdın akırına cheyin dagı on segizi achılat.
summary.ru: Школа на 24 класса стала двенадцатой школой или детским садом, построенными в этом году. До конца декабря откроются ещё восемнадцать.

en: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat on Monday opened a new school in Nurzhan's Navbahor district, the twelfth school or kindergarten completed this year under the ISEZ school building programme.

Eighteen more are due to open before the end of December: six in Talas, five in Nurzhan, three in Iyık Janyl and four in the district centres, among them Kyzyl-Adyr and Tash-Kömür. The programme is designed to clear the waiting lists for first-grade places in both cities by 2028.

The Navbahor building is the first in Irad designed to run largely on its own power, with about 100 kW of solar panels on its roof. Every school in the programme will now be built to the same standard. “A school that keeps its lights on when the grid is busy is a school that keeps teaching,” the Lieutenant Governor told pupils and parents. “This is what investment in our future looks like.”
The school's 24 classrooms will teach in English and Iradi from the first grade, with Russian as a subject. The next openings are planned in Talas later this month.

title.en: Magnitude 4.9 tremor in the Kara-Unkur valley: no damage reported
title.ir: Kara-Üñkür öröönündö 4,9 magnitudaluu jer titiröö: zıyan jok
title.ru: Землетрясение магнитудой 4,9 в долине Кара-Ункур: разрушений нет

summary.en: The district emergency service checked bridges, schools and the switchyard within the hour. Residents of older mudbrick houses are asked to check walls and chimneys before the heating season.
summary.ir: Aymaktık özgöchö kırdaal kızmatı bir saattın ichinde köpürölördü, mekteptterdi jana bölüshtürüü tüyünün teksherdi. Eski kirpich üylördö jashagandar jılytuu mezgilinin aldında dubaldardı jana trubany tekshersin.
summary.ru: Районная служба по чрезвычайным ситуациям в течение часа проверила мосты, школы и подстанцию. Жителей старых саманных домов просят проверить стены и дымоходы до начала отопительного сезона.

en: An earthquake of magnitude 4.9 shook the foothills of the Fergana Rim at 14:17 on Thursday. The epicentre was in the Kara-Unkur valley, a few kilometres north-east of Kyzyl-Unkur. Shaking was felt in Bazar-Korgon and lightly in Tash-Kömür.

“Our teams checked the bridges, the schools and the switchyard within the hour, and everything is in order,” said Nurlan Osmonkulov, head of the Lower Naryn District emergency service. Messages relayed through the UNMI liaison office reported no damage on the far side of the line.
Residents of older mudbrick houses are reminded to check walls and chimneys before the heating season and to report cracks to their local administration.

title.en: Bank of Irad: payment services require a licence
title.ir: Irad Bankı: tölöm kızmattarı üchün litsenziya kerek
title.ru: Банк Ирада: для платёжных услуг нужна лицензия

summary.en: Any service that takes payments or holds funds for residents of the ISEZ needs a licence under the 1993 Act, whatever the instrument it uses.
summary.ir: IAEZ turgundarınan tölöm kabıl algan je alardın karajatın saktagan ar kanday kızmat, kanday kural koldonbosun, 1993-jılkı Mıyzam boyuncha litsenziya alıshı kerek.
summary.ru: Любой сервис, который принимает платежи или хранит средства жителей ОЭЗИ, должен иметь лицензию по Закону 1993 года, независимо от используемого инструмента.

en: The Bank of Irad has written to the operators of payment services offered to residents of the Irad Special Economic Zone, reminding them that the acceptance of payments and the holding of customer funds are licensed activities under the Banking and Commercial Currency Act of 1993.

The letter refers among others to the payment service announced inside the Tulpar messaging application. A service does not escape licensing because the units it records are not money; it is the taking of payments and deposits that the Act regulates.
Residents are advised to make payments through licensed banks, and to treat any balance held with an unlicensed service as unprotected.

title.en: Executive Directive 2026/31 sets at least IS 41 million for school textbooks
title.ir: 2026/31 Atkaruu direktivası mektep okuu kitepterine keminde 41 million som bölöt
title.ru: Исполнительная директива 2026/31 выделяет не менее 41 млн сомов на школьные учебники

summary.en: A four-year printing programme for 2027–2030, expert review of every new title and a code on each copy showing the school and pupil it was issued to.
summary.ir: 2027–2030-jıldarga tört jıldık basuu programması, ar bir jañı kitepti eksperttik teksherüü jana ar bir nuskada kaysı mektepke, kaysı okuuchuga berilgenin körsötkön kod.
summary.ru: Четырёхлетняя программа печати на 2027–2030 годы, экспертиза каждого нового издания и код на каждом экземпляре с указанием школы и ученика.

en: Executive Directive 2026/31, published in the official gazette, sets aside at least IS 41 million to print textbooks for the zone's public schools over the next four years.

The Ministry of Education is to prepare a printing programme for 2027 to 2030 and submit it with next year's budget. A commission will review the curriculum and the books now in use; every new title must pass an expert review before copies are ordered, and authors and manuscripts will be chosen by competition.

Each copy will carry a QR code identifying the district, school, class and pupil it is issued to. “On paper we print enough copies, and still the schools tell us they are short,” said Dinara Seitkulova, head of the department's curriculum section, who will chair the commission. “Once a book has an address, we will know whether the problem is printing, delivery or something else.”
About 400,000 pupils attend ISEZ public schools.

title.en: Bank of Irad statement on the token marketed as “Tulparcoin”
title.ir: “Tulparcoin” dep satılıp jatkan token boyuncha Irad Bankının bildirüüsü
title.ru: Заявление Банка Ирада о токене, продвигаемом под названием «Тулпаркоин»

summary.en: The token is not legal tender, is not backed by the bank's dollar reserves and carries no deposit protection. Only the som and the US dollar are legal tender.
summary.ir: Token mıyzamduu tölöm karajatı emes, bankın dollar rezervi menen kamsızdalbagan jana depozit korgoosu jok. Som jana AKSh dolları gana mıyzamduu tölöm karajatı.
summary.ru: Токен не является законным платёжным средством, не обеспечен долларовыми резервами банка и не застрахован. Законные платёжные средства: сом и доллар США.

en: The Bank of Irad on Thursday warned the public about a digital token promoted online in recent days under the name “Tulparcoin”.

The token is not issued or backed by any Iradi institution, is not covered by the bank's dollar reserves and carries no deposit protection. Those who buy it do so entirely at their own risk. The som and the United States dollar remain the only legal tender in the Irad Special Economic Zone.

“The som has held its value at 8.40 to the dollar for eighteen years,” said the bank's deputy chairman, Ermek Sadykbekov. “That stability is the foundation of every family's savings, and it is not for sale on foreign websites.”

The Office of the Lieutenant Governor said it would work with banks and financial supervisors to protect citizens' savings from speculation. Residents with questions about investments should consult a licensed bank and report suspicious offers.

title.en: The Governor's greeting on the Feast of St. Janyl
title.ir: Gubernatordun Janıl Mayramı menen kuttuktoosu
title.ru: Поздравление губернатора с праздником Святой Джаныл

summary.en: Governor Erlan Toktarov greeted the faithful and the pilgrims gathered at Iyık Janyl. The address was broadcast on IradOne.
summary.ir: Gubernator Erlan Toktarov Iyık Janılga chogulgan ishengenderdi jana ziyaratchılardı kuttuktadı. Kayrıluu IradOne'do berildi.
summary.ru: Губернатор Эрлан Токтаров поздравил верующих и паломников, собравшихся в Ийык-Джаныле. Обращение передано по IradOne.

en: Governor Erlan Toktarov greeted the faithful and the pilgrims gathered at Iyık Janyl for the Feast of St. Janyl in a recorded address broadcast on IradOne.
The text of the address is published on the Governor's page.

title.en: ISEZ economy grew 1.5 per cent in 2024
title.ir: IAEZdin ekonomikası 2024-jılı 1,5 payyzga östü
title.ru: Экономика ОЭЗИ в 2024 году выросла на 1,5 процента

summary.en: Beef exports from the Talas valley and steady refinery output put growth ahead of the government's spring forecast.
summary.ir: Talas öröönünön uy etin eksporttoo jana NPZnın turuktuu ishi ösüshtü ökmöttün jazgı boljolunan jogoru kıldı.
summary.ru: Экспорт говядины из Таласской долины и стабильная работа НПЗ позволили превысить весенний прогноз правительства.

en: The economy of the Irad Special Economic Zone grew by 1.5 per cent in 2024, ahead of the forecast published by the government last spring.
Stronger beef exports from the Talas valley feedlots and steady throughput at the Nurzhan Oil Refinery offset softer cotton prices and higher costs for remittances routed through Almaty.
“The som has held its peg, our exporters have found buyers, and investment keeps coming to Talas,” said Azamat Temirov, chairman of the Bank of Irad.
The Office of the Lieutenant Governor will present the budget for the coming year to the Mejlis next month.

title.en: Memorandum on trade and border coordination signed with Uzbekistan
title.ir: Özbekstan menen sooda jana chek ara koordinatsiyası boyuncha memorandumga kol koyuldu
title.ru: С Узбекистаном подписан меморандум о торговле и пограничной координации

summary.en: Shared customs inspection hours at the main crossings and a joint working group on livestock and cotton shipments.
summary.ir: Negizgi ötkööldördö bajı teksherüüsünün jalpı saattarı jana mal menen paxta jönötüü boyuncha birgeleshken jumushchu top.
summary.ru: Общие часы таможенного досмотра на основных переходах и совместная рабочая группа по перевозкам скота и хлопка.

en: A memorandum on trade and border coordination between the Irad Special Economic Zone and Uzbekistan was signed on Monday at the offices of the Lieutenant Governor in Talas.

The memorandum commits the customs services on both sides to shared inspection hours at the main crossings near Bazar-Korgon and Tash-Kömür, and sets up a joint working group on livestock and cotton shipments. Patrols on the frontier will be coordinated by both sides.

“Our farmers and our hauliers have waited a long time for predictable crossings,” Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat said after the signing. “This is a practical agreement between neighbours who need each other.”
The working group will meet for the first time in Tash-Kömür in April.

title.en: Lieutenant Governor Presents Plan for a Refinery at Kochkor-Ata to Serve the Southern Districts
title.ir: Gubernatordun orunbasary Maksat tüshtük rayondorgo kyzmat kylgan Kochkor-Atadagy munay kayta ishteetüü zavodunun planyn taanyshtyrdy
title.ru: Вице-губернатор представил план нефтеперерабатывающего завода в Кочкор-Ате для южных районов

summary.en: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat told residents of Lower Naryn District that the government wants a second, smaller refinery at Kochkor-Ata to bring fuel closer to the southern districts. He described it as a plan to be studied, not a decision.
summary.ir: Gubernatordun orunbasary Aidar Maksat Töömönkü Naryn rayonunun turgundaryna tüshtük rayondordu küyüüchü may menen jakyn kamsyz kyluu üchün Kochkor-Atada ekinchi munay kayta ishteetüü zavodun kurgusu kelet dep ayttı. Al munu chechim emes, izildöö planı dep atady.
summary.ru: Вице-губернатор Аидар Максат сообщил жителям Нижненарынского района, что правительство хочет построить в Кочкор-Ате второй, небольшой НПЗ, чтобы приблизить топливо к южным районам. Он назвал это планом для изучения, а не решением.

en: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat on 23 October met local officials and residents of Lower Naryn District and set out the government's wish to build a second oil refinery at Kochkor-Ata, the Fergana rim market town of about 12,000 people.

The plant would process 450,000 tonnes a year, roughly 9,000 barrels a day, about a fifth of the 50,000 barrels a day handled by the Nurzhan Oil Refinery, Irad's only refinery. It would produce diesel, petrol and bitumen for the southern districts.

At present the southern districts receive their fuel from Nurzhan, about 600 km away by road and rail. Diesel sells at 6.10 som a litre at NurGaz stations and at 8.55 to 9.75 som a litre in the Chatkal villages, where it travels farthest.

"This is a plan to be studied, not a decision," the Lieutenant Governor told the meeting. The government intends to examine the proposal carefully and together with the people who live in the district. Investors and the timetable will be taken up as the study proceeds.
Alisher Kholmatov, head of the Lower Naryn District administration, said the district would offer officials' help with the study and with any questions from residents.

The proposal forms part of the government's work to bring investment and services to the districts outside the three cities, alongside the Nurzhan Compute Park and the Bazar-Korgon school programme. Further details will be presented to the cabinet once the study is complete.

title.en: Record 700 Participants Attend Nurzhan Oil and Gas Conference
title.ir: Nurzhan Munay jana Gaz Konferentsiyasyna rekorddik 700 katyshuuchu katyshty
title.ru: Рекордные 700 участников собрала Нуржанская нефтегазовая конференция

summary.en: The annual Nurzhan Oil and Gas Conference, hosted by NurGaz and opened by the Minister of Natural Resources, closed on 23 October with about 700 registered participants, some 40% more than in 2025.
summary.ir: NurGaz uyushturgan jyldyk Nurzhan Munay jana Gaz Konferentsiyasy 23-oktyabrda jabyldy: 2025-jylga karaganda 40 payyzga köp, 700gö jakyn katyshuuchu katyshty.
summary.ru: Ежегодная Нуржанская нефтегазовая конференция, организованная НурГаз и открытая министром природных ресурсов, завершилась 23 октября: зарегистрировались около 700 участников, примерно на 40% больше, чем в 2025 году.

en: NurGaz's annual Nurzhan Oil and Gas Conference closed on Friday 23 October at the Palace of Metallurgists in Nurzhan with about 700 registered participants. That is roughly 40% more than the 500 or so who attended in 2025, making this the largest gathering in the history of the event.

Delegates came mostly from Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, China and Turkey, together with oilfield service firms and consultants. Minister of Natural Resources Chingiz Asanov opened the programme. "Irad's reserves are an asset for Iradis first," the Minister told the hall, "and we are glad the region wants to sit down and talk about them."

Over three days, panels examined Chu-basin crude and the Nurzhan Oil Refinery, Irad's only refinery; the proposed Trans-Irad Gas Pipeline; gas for heat plants and the planned Nurzhan Compute Park; and the capped Muyunkum field in the Moiynkum Desert. Participants also noted that the refitted units of the Toktogul power station, now rated at 1,440 MW, keep Irad a dependable power exporter to its neighbours.

The proposed pipeline attracted the fullest sessions. It would carry gas in transit only, and organisers recalled that the project requires the agreement of Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan as well as the consent of the clans whose land the route would cross. The Northern Export Feeder carries crude oil only; Irad has no gas export line at present.

The planned Nurzhan Compute Park and the planned conversion of the Nurzhan central heat and power plant were presented as part of the effort to serve Irad's own homes and industry. Irad's proven gas reserves are put at more than 400 billion cubic metres. NurGaz, the host company, will publish the conference proceedings in the coming weeks.

title.en: Record Harvest Lifts ISEZ Farm Output to IS 6.1 Billion in Nine Months
title.ir: Rekorddik hosul toguz ayda ayıl charba önümün IS 6,1 milliardga jetkirdi
title.ru: Рекордный урожай поднял объём сельхозпродукции ОЭЗ Ирад до 6,1 млрд сомов за девять месяцев

summary.en: The Ministry of Economy's preliminary estimate puts ISEZ agricultural output for January to September 2026 at IS 6.1 billion, with volume up about 12% on the same period of 2025. The result is one of the pillars of the 9.4% growth reported by the Bank of Irad.
summary.ir: Ekonomika Ministrliginin aldyn ala baalamasy boyuncha, 2026-jyldyn yanvar–sentyabr aylarynda ISEZ ayıl charba önümü IS 6,1 milliardga jetti, kölömü ötkön jylga salyshtyrganda about 12% östü. Bul Irad Bankı jarıyalagan 9,4% östüürdün tayanychtarynyn biri.
summary.ru: По предварительной оценке Министерства экономики, объём сельхозпродукции ОЭЗ Ирад за январь–сентябрь 2026 года составил 6,1 млрд сомов, физический объём вырос примерно на 12% к аналогичному периоду 2025 года. Результат стал одной из опор роста в 9,4%, о котором сообщил Банк Ирада.

en: The Ministry of Economy has published its preliminary estimate of agricultural output in the Irad Special Economic Zone for the first nine months of 2026. Between January and September the ISEZ produced farm goods worth IS 6.1 billion, or about $726 million at the official rate of 8.40 som to the dollar.

Output volume rose by about 12% on the same period of 2025, carried by the grain and potato harvests of Chu District and Talas District. The value of output rose by about 6%, as bazaar prices for potatoes eased with the abundance of the crop. Crops account for roughly two-thirds of the total, with livestock and dairy making up the remainder.
The farm result is one of the pillars of the 9.4% economic growth for the first nine months that the Bank of Irad reported on 20 to 22 October.

Bekbolot Sherov, press secretary of the Ministry of Economy, said the result reflected "more grain and more potatoes from the same land." The ministry credits the Irrigation Modernization Programme, which since 2018 has paid for canal lining, laser levelling and drip systems across the valleys. The farm belt has also been among the priorities of the Lieutenant Governor's office this autumn.

The abundant harvest is reflected in full barns, in livestock feed and in the stocks that households and farms are laying in for winter, with brisk buying of potatoes and apples reported at the Bazar-i Kalan.

The ministry notes that the figures are preliminary. Final numbers will be published with the annual review, after the business census, which counts bazaar stalls and farms for the first time, closes on 30 November.

title.en: Investment in Sary-Bulak District's Mining Sector Reaches US$216.6 Million
title.ir: Sary-Bulak rayonunun tau-ken sektoruna investitsiya 216,6 million dollarga jetti
title.ru: Инвестиции в горнодобывающий сектор района Сары-Булак достигли 216,6 млн долларов США

summary.en: On a working visit to Sary-Bulak District on Thursday, Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat was informed that investment in the district's mining sector has reached US$216.6 million. Investors have indicated that about 2% of their sales will go towards district roads, schools and clinics.
summary.ir: Payshembi künü jumush saparı menen Sary-Bulak rayonunda bolgon Gubernatordun orunbasary Aidar Maksatka rayondun tau-ken sektoruna investitsiya 216,6 million dollarga jetkeni bildirildi. Investorlor satuunun taxminan 2 payyzyn rayondun jol, mektep jana klinikalaryna bagyttoo nietin bildirishti.
summary.ru: Во время рабочей поездки в район Сары-Булак в четверг вице-губернатору Айдару Максату сообщили, что инвестиции в горнодобывающий сектор района достигли 216,6 млн долларов США. Инвесторы дали понять, что около 2% от продаж будет направлено на районные дороги, школы и клиники.

en: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat on Thursday made a working visit to Sary-Bulak District, where he toured the district's works and met local officials.

The Sary-Bulak District Administration reported to the Lieutenant Governor that investment in the district's mining sector has reached US$216.6 million. The figure covers funds pledged and already spent since 2024 across the Sary-Bulak Antimony Works, the Chatkal Chemical Smelting Complex, the Kemer Antimony Mine and the firms that supply them. All three sites are within the Irad Special Economic Zone, and the concessions under which they operate are granted through the Ministry of Natural Resources, headed by Minister Chingiz Asanov.

District head Taalaibek Imashev informed the Lieutenant Governor that investors have indicated that about 2% of their sales will be directed towards district roads, schools and clinics. The district administration intends to follow the matter closely with the investors concerned.

Mr Maksat noted the district's needs in roads and public services, familiar to anyone travelling the Chatkal road. "Investment is welcome, and what stays in the valley matters as much as what leaves it," he said.

The district's total sits within the US$2.4 billion of investment agreements reported across the Zone on 19 October. The figures presented on Thursday concern property inside the Zone only; the Chatkal Highlands beyond the Qara-Chik line, which remain under the open-pit mining moratorium, are not part of them.

title.en: Lower Naryn District to Complete Water Storage Tank for Rim Villages in 2027 Budget
title.ir: Tömönkü Naryn rayonu suu saktagych tankty 2027-jylkı byudjetten bütüröt
title.ru: Нижне-Нарынский район достроит резервуар для воды в селах предгорья за счёт бюджета 2027 года

summary.en: Following a Talas State University household survey in Korgoncho, Sopol-Tepa and Kyzyl-Oktyabr, the Lower Naryn District Administration has announced that it will fund the completion of the water scheme's storage tank in the 2027 budget.
summary.ir: Talas Mamlekettik Universitetinin üy-bülö suroosunan kiyin Tömönkü Naryn rayonunun administratsiyasy Korgoncho, Sopol-Tepa jana Kyzyl-Oktyabr suu sistemasynyn saktagych tankyn 2027-jylkı byudjetten bütürüü nietin jarıyaladı.
summary.ru: После опроса домохозяйств, проведённого Таласским государственным университетом в Коргончо, Сопол-Тепа и Кызыл-Октябре, администрация Нижне-Нарынского района объявила, что достроит резервуар системы водоснабжения за счёт бюджета 2027 года.

en: The Lower Naryn District Administration announced on Monday that it will pay for the completion of the water storage tank serving the villages of Korgoncho, Sopol-Tepa and Kyzyl-Oktyabr in the 2027 budget, which goes to the Mejlis this month.

The decision follows a household survey carried out in October by hydrologists of Talas State University, led by Dr Bermet Asylova. The team questioned about 640 households in the three villages of the Fergana rim farm belt. It found that residents receive tap water for an average of 11.4 hours a day.

The survey confirms that the pumping stations and pipe network of the Korgoncho Rural Water Supply Scheme, completed in 2021 with a foreign development partner's grant and co-financing from the Rural Development Fund, do what they were built to do. The storage tank was built to about 60 per cent of its design volume, which limits the water the pumps can hold in reserve for the evening peak. Completing the tank is expected to extend the hours of supply to households.

Alisher Kholmatov, head of the Lower Naryn District Administration, said: "The scheme works, and it serves many families. We will finish what was left unfinished." The administration will also approach the project's partners for the documents needed to close out the work.

The measure is in line with the emphasis the Lieutenant Governor has placed on reliable public services for the villages of the Fergana rim. The district administration will report on progress once the 2027 budget has been adopted.

title.en: ISEZ Notes Appointment of New Secretary General of the Organization of Turkic States
title.ir: Türk Mamleketteri Uyumunun bash katchysy: Özbekstandyn diplomaty
title.ru: ОЭЗИ принимает к сведению назначение нового генерального секретаря Организации тюркских государств

summary.en: The Irad Special Economic Zone has noted the appointment of Uzbekistan's deputy foreign minister as Secretary General of the Organization of Turkic States. The External Relations Office expects daily business with Uzbek officials to continue as before.
summary.ir: Özbekstandyn Tashky ishter ministrinin orunbasary Ankarada Türk Mamleketteri Uyumunun bash katchysy bolup dayyndaldy. Irad koshunalar menen kündölük mamilesin ulantat.
summary.ru: ОЭЗИ приняла к сведению назначение заместителя министра иностранных дел Узбекистана генеральным секретарём Организации тюркских государств. Управление внешних сношений ожидает, что повседневная работа с узбекскими должностными лицами продолжится в прежнем порядке.

en: The Organization of Turkic States has appointed Uzbekistan's deputy foreign minister as its Secretary General at its summit in Ankara. He is the first Uzbek to hold the post. The organization brings together Turkey, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan and other partners, and its secretariat coordinates the members' work on transport, trade and cultural exchange.

The Irad Special Economic Zone has noted the appointment. Irad belongs to no intergovernmental body and holds no seat or observer status in the organization. The External Relations Office, which handles the ISEZ's dealings with the neighbours' agencies, UNMI and the United States, set out its position briefly.

"Our office works with the neighbours' agencies, with UNMI and with the Americans, not with regional organizations," said the Director of the External Relations Office, Nathan Kenjeev. "We note the appointment and we expect our daily business with Uzbek officials to go on as it does now."

That daily business is well established. The ISEZ's frontier with Uzbekistan runs about 145 km along the Fergana rim. Since the February 2025 memorandum on trade and border coordination, signed at the offices of the Lieutenant Governor in Talas, customs inspection hours have been shared at the main crossings near Bazar-Korgon and Tash-Kömür. A joint working group on livestock and cotton shipments has met at Tash-Kömür.

The Zone's ties with Turkey are practical and commercial. Kervan Elektrik, a Turkish operator, manages the power networks of Talas, Nurzhan, Chu District and Kara-Buura District under management contracts. Iradiya flies from Talas to Istanbul on Fridays, with a technical stop at Baku, and about 1,500 Iradi students attend Turkish universities. These links will continue.

title.en: Camera Traps Record Two Snow Leopards in Upper Besh-Tash for the First Time in Decades
title.ir: Jogorku Besh-Tash jylgasynda eki ilbirs kamerada tirkeldi
title.ru: В верховьях Беш-Таша фотоловушки зафиксировали двух снежных барсов впервые за десятилетия

summary.en: The Forestry and Protected Areas Service reports that camera traps in the upper Besh-Tash valley have recorded two snow leopards, the first confirmed there in decades. Rangers, Talas State University scientists and Akjele elders are discussing steps to keep the animals and the returning flocks apart.
summary.ir: Tabigiy Resurstar Ministrliginin Tokoy jana Korgoolgon Aymaktar Kyzmaty Jogorku Besh-Tash jylgasynda eki ilbirs kamerada tirkelgenin bildirdi. Korgoochular, TSU ilimpozdoru jana Akjele aksakaldary mal menen ilbirstardy bölüp saktoo boyuncha süyloshüp jatat.
summary.ru: Служба лесного хозяйства и охраняемых территорий сообщила, что фотоловушки в верховьях долины Беш-Таш зафиксировали двух снежных барсов, впервые за десятилетия. Рейнджеры, учёные ТГУ и старейшины акжеле обсуждают меры, чтобы развести зверей и возвращающиеся с пастбищ стада.

en: Camera traps in the upper Besh-Tash valley have recorded two snow leopards moving along the high ridges, the first confirmed in that valley in decades, the Forestry and Protected Areas Service of the Ministry of Natural Resources announced on Friday.

The images are being read by the Besh-Tash Ranger Headquarters together with the Ilbirs Station, the research and rehabilitation station that Talas State University opened at Uuk-Bulak on 23 October. Dr Aizhan Torobekova, head of the station, said the pair most likely came from the Chatkal hills. For a snow leopard, she noted, the Chatkal Highlands and the Talas Alatau are one range, and the ridges above Besh-Tash are good ground for the species.

"A snow leopard returning to a valley is the best report that a protected area can receive," said Minister of Natural Resources Chingiz Asanov. The core zone of the Besh-Tash National Park covers about 11,000 hectares of its 32,400.

As the herds come down from the summer pastures, rangers are preparing measures to keep animals and flocks apart. They include night corrals for stock left on the high ground, a call line on which herders can report tracks or sightings, and regular checks of the camera traps. No livestock loss or incident has been reported.

The upper valley is tribal land, so the measures there depend on the agreement of the Akjele elders. Rangers and elders have been discussing the plan, and the talks are proceeding in a cooperative spirit.

The two animals are being observed by camera alone. No capture, collar or release is planned, and the Ilbirs Station asks walkers and herders not to go looking for them. The Ranger Headquarters will report again once the images have been fully analysed and the elders have given their answer on the herd-protection steps.

source.en: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection

title.en: Ministry of Labour: Register of Migrants' Families Remains Basis for Allowances
title.ir: Emgek jana sotsialdyk korgoo ministrligi: migranttardyn üy-bülölörünün tizmesi kömök tölöönün negizi bolup kalat
title.ru: Минтруд: реестр семей мигрантов остаётся основой для выплаты пособий

summary.en: The Ministry of Labour and Social Protection confirmed that its register of migrants' families, set up in 2022, remains the basis for allowances paid at Irad Pochtasy counters to households that depend on wages earned abroad.
summary.ir: Emgek jana sotsialdyk korgoo ministrligi 2022-jyly düzülgön migranttardyn üy-bülölörünün tizmesi chet ölkölördö tapkan jalaka tayangan üy-bülölörgö Irad Pochtasynyn kassalarynda tölöngön kömökpulunun negizi bolup kalganyn bildirdi.
summary.ru: Министерство труда и социальной защиты подтвердило, что реестр семей мигрантов, созданный в 2022 году, остаётся основой для выплаты пособий в кассах «Ирадпочты» домохозяйствам, которые живут на заработок, полученный за границей.

en: The Ministry of Labour and Social Protection on Friday confirmed that its register of migrants' families remains the basis on which allowances are paid to households in the Irad Special Economic Zone that depend on wages earned abroad.

Money sent home from Russia alone is estimated at US$250–400 million a year, and remittances as a whole are put at 5–8% of the Zone's output. Most Iradi migrants in Russia travel on Kyrgyz passports and work under Eurasian Union rules. Their transfers reach families in Talas, Nurzhan and Bazar-Korgon through Russian and Kazakh transfer services and Almaty correspondent banks, and are received through Talasbank's SMS service, which notifies the recipient when funds arrive and pays out in som at the official rate of 8.40 to the dollar.

The register was set up in 2022. It allows the ministry to identify which households rely on a wage earned in Russia or Kazakhstan, and the allowance is then paid at the counters of Irad Pochtasy, which operates some 190 post offices across the Zone.
"The register tells us which households depend on a wage earned abroad, and the allowance reaches them at the post office," said Minister of Labour and Social Protection Aikerim Kalbaeva.
The ministry noted that the cost and route of transfers are a matter of concern to many families. Work on the cost of transfers continues, and no new measures have been announced at this time.
Families whose circumstances have changed are invited to contact their nearest district office of the ministry or their post office.

title.en: Ministry of Health Proposes IS 126 Million for Polyclinics and Village Health Posts in 2027 Budget
title.ir: Den sooluk saktoo ministrligi 2027-jylga poliklinikalar jana ayyl medpunktary üchün 126 million som saktoonu sunushtady
title.ru: Минздрав предлагает выделить 126 млн сомов на поликлиники и сельские медпункты в бюджете 2027 года

summary.en: The Ministry of Health has proposed a primary-care line of IS 126 million, about US$15 million at the official rate, in the draft 2027 budget. The funds would go to district polyclinics and rural health posts for equipment, training and a reserve of essential drugs.
summary.ir: Den sooluk saktoo ministrligi 2027-jylga budjettin dolboorunda algachky medicinalyk jardamga 126 million som, rasmiy kurs boyuncha 15 million AKSh dollaryna jakyn, saktoonu surady. Karajat poliklinikalarga jana ayyl medpunktaryna uskunalarga, okutuuga jana dary-darmek koruna berilet.
summary.ru: Министерство здравоохранения внесло в проект бюджета ОЭЗИ на 2027 год строку в 126 млн сомов (около 15 млн долларов США по официальному курсу) на первичную медицинскую помощь. Средства предназначены для районных поликлиник и сельских медпунктов: оборудование, обучение и резерв основных лекарств.

en: The Ministry of Health has proposed a line of IS 126 million, about US$15 million at the official rate of 8.40 som to the dollar, for primary care in the draft 2027 budget of the Irad Special Economic Zone. The draft budget goes to the Mejlis this month.

The funds are intended for district polyclinics and rural health posts. The ministry names three purposes: diagnostic equipment, refresher training for family doctors and nurses, and a reserve of essential drugs from which the health posts could draw without waiting for a delivery from the city.

Minister of Health Jamila Kubatova said the aim is to bring proper care closer to the patient. "If a patient can be seen properly at the polyclinic or the village post, that patient does not need a bed in Talas," she said. Equipment and training are planned for every district of the Zone; the division between them will be set at a later stage.

The ministry expects stronger primary care to allow the Talas Regional Hospital Medical Complex to concentrate on the specialist treatment that only a referral hospital can provide. The refresher courses are intended for family doctors and for nurses, who are often the first point of medical contact in rural communities.

The line would be paid from the budget of the Zone alone, which the ministry presents as a domestic commitment to the health of residents. Only a summary of the draft budget is published, and allocations for individual districts have yet to be released.
The Mejlis is expected to consider the 2027 draft in the coming weeks. The budget is normally adopted in December.

source.en: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources
source.ir: Ayyl charba jana suu resurstary ministrligi
source.ru: Министерство сельского хозяйства и водных ресурсов

title.en: Cotton Picking Ends with the Largest Crop in the Ministry's Records Since 2007
title.ir: Pakhta termesi 41 000 tonna menen ayaktady
title.ru: Сбор хлопка завершается самым большим урожаем с 2007 года

summary.en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources reports that the 2026 cotton picking in the Zone is nearly finished, with a raw-cotton crop of about 41,000 tonnes, the largest in its records since 2007. Steady canal water and a full Toktogul reservoir supported the season.
summary.ir: Ayyl charba jana suu resurstary ministrligi 2026-jyldyn pakhta termesi ayaktap kaldy dep bildirdi: pakhta tüshümü 41 000 tonna.
summary.ru: Министерство сельского хозяйства и водных ресурсов сообщает, что сбор хлопка 2026 года в Зоне почти завершён: урожай хлопка-сырца оценён примерно в 41 тысячу тонн, это наибольший показатель в записях министерства с 2007 года.

en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources on Saturday announced that the 2026 cotton picking in the Irad Special Economic Zone is nearly finished. The raw-cotton crop is put at about 41,000 tonnes, the largest in the Ministry's records since 2007.
All of the crop was grown on the Fergana rim farm belt round Bazar-Korgon, Korgoncho and Sopol-Tepa in Lower Naryn District.

Minister of Agriculture and Water Resources Melis Nurmatov announced the figure and the end of picking. "I thank every farm family, every driver and every picker who stayed in the field until the last boll," the Minister said.

Steady water supported the season. The canals held through the summer, and the Toktogul reservoir stood 86.2% full on 6 November, so the rim farms did not face the irrigation rotas of 2021 and 2023. Alisher Kholmatov, head of the Lower Naryn District administration, noted that farmers in the district were able to plan their sowing, labour and loans with confidence in the water supply.

The cotton is ginned at the Xinjiang Lihua facilities in Chu District, and the cottonseed is pressed for oil at the Bazar-Korgon oil mill. Part of the fibre goes on to Zhetysu Industrial Textiles in Nurzhan. The Ministry thanks the farms, gin and mill workers and drivers whose work carried the harvest through to its close.

source.en: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources

title.en: Farm-Machinery Service Centre to Open at Kara-Bulak Before Spring Sowing
title.ir: Kara-Bulakta ayıl charba tehnikasyna kyzmat körsötüü borboru achylat
title.ru: В Кара-Булаке откроется сервисный центр для сельхозтехники к весеннему севу

summary.en: Alatau Agro Machinery LLC has announced a US$3 million service and parts centre beside the Talas–Nurzhan road at Kara-Bulak, financed by Talasbank and the Rural Development Fund. The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources welcomed the project, which is due to open before the 2027 spring sowing.
summary.ir: Alatau Agro Machinery kompaniyasy Kara-Bulakta 3 million dollarlyk kyzmat körsötüü borborunun achyshyn jarıyaladı. Borbor 2027-jylky jazgy eginge cheyin achylat.
summary.ru: Компания «Alatau Agro Machinery» объявила о создании в Кара-Булаке сервисного центра стоимостью 3 млн долларов США при финансовой поддержке Талазбанка и Фонда развития села. Центр должен открыться до весеннего сева 2027 года.

en: Alatau Agro Machinery LLC, the Talas dealer that has sold and serviced John Deere tractors and combines since 1995, on Saturday announced a service and parts centre beside the Talas–Nurzhan road at Kara-Bulak, close to the Kara-Bulak Grain Logistics Depot.

The project is valued at US$3 million (IS 25.2 million at the official rate). About US$2 million is provided as a Talasbank loan, and the Rural Development Fund is co-financing about US$1 million. Alatau Agro Machinery is contributing the land and its existing workshop.

The centre is to have repair bays, a parts warehouse and a training room for mechanics, and will provide work for about 35 staff. The company has set the opening for the period before the 2027 spring sowing, with construction to proceed through the winter. Recruitment of mechanics and trainees will begin once building starts.

The announcement follows a record cotton harvest of 41,000 tonnes on the Fergana rim, and a maize and potato harvest that has filled cellars and silos across the valleys. Farms in the Chu and Talas valleys have asked where their combines and tractors can be repaired before the next season begins.

The Minister of Agriculture and Water Resources, Melis Nurmatov, welcomed the project. "A good harvest is only as good as the machine that brings it in," the Minister said. "Farmers should know that a repair is a short drive away."

The Rural Development Fund, directed by Kanybek Zhorobekov, will take part in the project through its co-financing share. The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources will continue to follow preparations for the coming sowing season.

source.en: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources

title.en: Ministry Notes Neighbour's Record Cotton Crop as Zone's Growers Look to Yield, Water and Machines
title.ir: Ministrlik koshunanyn pakhta rekordun belgiledi: Zonanyn dykandary tüshümgö, suuga jana tekhnikaga köngül burat
title.ru: Министерство отметило рекордный урожай хлопка у соседа: аграрии Зоны смотрят на урожайность, воду и технику

summary.en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources noted Uzbekistan's reported cotton harvest of more than 5 million tonnes, set beside the Zone's own record picking on the Fergana-rim farm belt. It said the questions of yield, water and mechanical picking are ones the Zone's growers already address.
summary.ir: Ayyl charba jana suu resurstary ministrligi Özbekstanda 5 million tonnadan ashkan pakhta tüshümün belgiledi. Ministrlik tüshüm, suu jana tekhnika Zonanyn dykandarlary üchün da mayyzdu suroolor ekenin bildirdi.
summary.ru: Министерство сельского хозяйства и водных ресурсов отметило сообщённый Узбекистаном урожай хлопка более 5 млн тонн. Вопросы урожайности, воды и механизированной уборки, отметило ведомство, уже стоят перед аграриями Зоны.

en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources on Thursday noted the report from Uzbekistan that it has harvested more than 5 million tonnes of cotton this year, the first crop of that size in 35 years.

According to the Uzbek government, the crop was gathered on roughly half the area sown in 1990, average yields have more than doubled over the period, and machines took about 85 per cent of this autumn's harvest.

The Ministry recalled that on 7 November the government's press office announced the end of cotton picking in the Zone, with the largest crop in the Ministry's records since 2007, grown on the Fergana-rim farm belt of Lower Naryn District. The Uzbek figure is a neighbour's result and not an Iradi one, the Ministry said, but it points to questions that the Zone's growers already work on: how much fibre a hectare can give, how much water it requires, and how the crop is picked.

On water, the Ministry pointed to the Irrigation Modernization Programme, which has run since 2018 and provides for canal lining, laser levelling of fields and drip irrigation. Minister of Agriculture and Water Resources Melis Nurmatov has said that saving water in the canal is the cheapest harvest a farm can gain.

On machines, the Ministry noted that after picking the crop is ginned in Chu District, where Xinjiang Lihua holds ginning concessions. The Ministry will take the experience of neighbouring countries into account in its work on preparations for the 2027 sowing.

title.en: Bread, Fares and Fuel Hold Steady in Som Across Talas and Nurzhan
title.ir: Talas men Nurzhanda nan, jol kire jana otun baasy turuktuu
title.ru: Хлеб, проезд и топливо в Таласе и Нуржане сохраняют цены в сомах

summary.en: A price check at Bazar-i Kalan and the Talas Central Bus Station shows that the price of bread, intercity fares and diesel is steady in som. The Ministry of Economy says wages and fares are set in som and paid in som.
summary.ir: Bazar-i Kalan men Talas borborduk avtovokzalynda baa tekseruu: nan, jol kire jana dizel baasy somdo turuktuu. Ekonomika ministrligi: jalaky jana jol kire somdo belgilenet jana somdo tölönöt.
summary.ru: Проверка цен на базаре Базар-и Калан и на Таласском центральном автовокзале показала, что цены на хлеб, междугородный проезд и дизельное топливо в сомах стабильны. Министерство экономики напоминает, что зарплаты и тарифы устанавливаются и выплачиваются в сомах.

en: A price check carried out on Monday 9 November at Bazar-i Kalan and the Talas Central Bus Station confirmed that the prices of the main everyday goods and services in the Irad Special Economic Zone remain steady in som.

A loaf of nan cost 3.50 som in Talas. The bus fare from Talas to Nurzhan was 32 som and the marshrutka fare 38 som. Diesel at NurGaz stations was 6.10 som a litre. Staples grown in the Zone are flat or falling in price following this year's harvest.

The one recent change was on the Talas–Kyzyl-Adyr marshrutka, where the fare rose from 24 to 30 som on 19 October. The adjustment followed higher diesel costs on the route, a stated reason in line with the established practice for changes to public fares.

The Bank of Irad's official rate remains 8.40 som to the US dollar, the rate in force since 17 March 2008. Public wages, pensions, utilities and transport fares continue to be paid and charged in som at that rate. The latest published consumer price index of the Territorial Statistics Office is 7.9% year on year for September 2026, and the Office's next bulletin will give the full picture.

"Wages and fares are set in som and paid in som," said Bekbolot Sherov, press secretary of the Ministry of Economy, restating the ministry's position. The Ministry will continue to monitor prices of food, fuel and transport and to publish its findings.
